subject: Concordia / Redwood — Partner Immersion blueprint and pilot schedule
messages:
From: Emma Hart <emma.hart@concordia-consulting.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Concordia / Redwood — Immersion bootcamp proposal

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Concordia leadership team is excited about the potential to embed Redwood into a set of proof-of-value engagements we run for enterprise customers. We put together a short draft agenda for a 3-day "Partner Immersion" that blends sales enablement, technical deep dives, and a hands-on lab for our consultants.

High-level goals:
- Enable 8 consultants to be confident in positioning Redwood on SOWs and TCO conversations
- One working integration (sandbox) by Day 3 that demonstrates a chat assistant + embeddings search
- Clear handoff artefacts (playbook, runbook, sample prompts) we can reuse across accounts

Attached: Concordia_Immersion_Draft_Agenda.pdf (draft agenda + expected attendees).

Questions for you:
1) Does Redwood have a recommended session split for sales vs technical content?
2) Can you provide sandbox credentials and a lightweight guide for model selection/quantization best practices?
3) What dates in April work for your enablement team? We are targeting the week of April 22 but are flexible.

Appreciate any notes — happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
Emma Hart
Head of Partnerships | Concordia Consulting
attachments: Concordia_Immersion_Draft_Agenda.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Hart <emma.hart@concordia-consulting.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concordia / Redwood — Immersion bootcamp proposal

Emma — thanks for the thoughtful draft and congrats on running such a clean POC motion. Short answers up front: yes, we have a recommended split, we can deliver sandbox access, and April 22 week is workable with a couple caveats (see below).

Quick thoughts on your goals:
- Sales vs technical split: 40% sales (positioning, economics, field objections), 40% technical (integration patterns, runtime tradeoffs, SLOs), 20% hands-on lab and handoffs.
- Sandbox: we can provision a temporary tenant with limited quota and a pre-seeded dataset for embeddings. That includes ephemeral API keys and a lightweight runbook.

Requests / constraints:
- We need confirmed attendee list by Apr 8 to provision training accounts.
- For the lab, a machine-readable sample dataset (CSV/JSON) helps — could Concordia bring anonymized customer transcripts?
- Our enablement engineers need one full-day prep slot the week prior to sanity-check the lab environment.

I attached a short internal runbook we've used for other SI immersions (Redwood-Partner-Runbook-v1.docx) — it outlines session owners, minimum infra, and fallbacks (model downgrade path, regional routing).

Proposed timeline:
- Apr 8: Attendee list / dataset due (Concordia)
- Apr 15: Redwood runbook prep call (1 hour)
- Apr 22–24: Immersion (three half-day remote sessions + one in-person lab day if desired)

If that looks OK I'll have Lauren coordinate the logistics and Sean will cover the technical lab. I'd also like to capture an MSA/SOW conversation in parallel — are you able to route a draft SOW before the 8th?

Thanks — talk soon.

—Rishi
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood-Partner-Runbook-v1.docx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Hart <emma.hart@concordia-consulting.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Mar 2029 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concordia / Redwood — Immersion bootcamp proposal

Emma / Rishi — looping in some of the logistics so we can lock dates. Sean and I sketched session ownership below; feel free to push back.

Session draft (Day / Owner / Outcome):
- Day 1 AM — GTM positioning & economics (Lauren) — outcome: one-page battlecard and objection playbook
- Day 1 PM — Architecture patterns & security (Sean) — outcome: checklist for VPC/private deploys + data flow diagrams
- Day 2 AM — Integration lab setup (Sean) — outcome: working embedding/index + chat demo against seeded dataset
- Day 2 PM — Performance & cost controls (Redwood infra lead) — outcome: tuning guide + suggested quantization profiles
- Day 3 — Handoff & customer adoption playbook (Lauren + Rishi) — outcome: partner-facing playbook and sample proposal language

Logistics notes:
- Training accounts: we will create 8 sandbox accounts and one "trainer" account with elevated ops permissions. Please send the anonymized dataset to the Drive folder below by Apr 8.
- Drive link for materials & runbooks: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xYz-concordia-immersion
- We will record the sessions and deliver slides + a one-page runbook.

Costs: The enablement team will run this as a partner success engagement. There is a $6,500 one-time enablement fee and standard Redwood consumption pricing applies to sandbox usage. If Concordia prefers Redwood-applied marketing credits in lieu of the fee, we can discuss.

Next steps:
1) Emma — confirm week of Apr 22 and attendee list by Apr 8
2) Emma — send anonymized dataset to the Drive folder
3) Rishi/Sean — schedule the prep call Apr 15

Lauren Bishop
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Emma Hart <emma.hart@concordia-consulting.com>

Subject: Re: Concordia / Redwood — Immersion bootcamp proposal

Rishi / Lauren — great, we are aligned on the structure and the week of Apr 22 works. Confirming next steps:
- Attendee list (8): I'll send names and titles the week of Mar 18 and will include two sales leads + six consultants.
- Dataset: we'll drop a redacted conversation corpus into the Drive folder by Apr 5.
- SOW: attached is a signed, minimal SOW for the enablement engagement (Signed-SOW-Concordia.pdf). Please let me know if you need additional PO info — I will follow up to route the formal purchasing details.

Also, a quick note on the sandbox: Concordia prefers an up-to-3-week retention window for the sandbox indices. Is that compatible with Redwood's policies? If not, we'll accept the shorter TTLs and export screenshots during the lab.

Looking forward to the prep call on Apr 15.

Best,
Emma Hart
Head of Partnerships | Concordia Consulting
